### `entries_map`

```badger
fn entries_map<K, V, U>(m: Map<K, V>, f: fn((K, V)) -> U) -> List<U>
```

One trie walk for `entries().map(..)`: the compiler lowers that chain
here, so no intermediate entry list is built. The callback receives the
entry tuple.
